restaurants.name: Pingpong
restaurants.description: Neighborhood favorite serving Chinese, Thai, and other Asian-inspired dishes with creative cocktails in a casual, lively setting.

restaurants.name: Wangs
restaurants.description: Intimate cocktail lounge and restaurant with Chinese-inspired dishes and sushi, famous for its matcha martini.

restaurants.name: Le Petit Marcel
restaurants.description: Parisian-inspired bistro serving escargot, steak tartare, and other French classics with a cozy piano bar.

restaurants.name: RPM Seafood
restaurants.description: Riverfront seafood restaurant with crudo, seafood towers, and signature pastas with floor-to-ceiling Chicago River views.

restaurants.name: RPM Steak
restaurants.description: Upscale modern steakhouse with globally sourced cuts in an elegant space centered around a wraparound marble bar.

restaurants.name: Aba
restaurants.description: Rooftop Mediterranean restaurant with creative hummus variations, wood-fired lamb chops, and a gorgeous patio.

restaurants.name: Ema
restaurants.description: Aba's sister restaurant serving lighter Mediterranean mezze and small plates with standout hummus, falafel, and kebabs.

restaurants.name: Bar Mar
restaurants.description: José Andrés' seafood-focused spot blending Spanish and Latin flavors through ceviches, crudos, and elevated coastal classics.

restaurants.name: Obelix
restaurants.description: Modern French bistro from James Beard-nominated chefs, known for beef Wellington, foie gras, and rotating soufflés.

restaurants.name: Kit Kat Club
restaurants.description: Glamorous Art Deco supper club with American cuisine, drag brunches, live performances, and over 200 cocktails.

restaurants.name: Summer House Santa Monica
restaurants.description: California-inspired restaurant with a retractable glass ceiling, wood-fired dishes, market pastas, and a signature cookie bar.

restaurants.name: RL Restaurant
restaurants.description: Ralph Lauren's clubby restaurant on Michigan Ave with classic American fare and tableside service.

restaurants.name: Gibsons
restaurants.description: Legendary Chicago steakhouse on Rush Street since 1989, serving USDA Prime Angus aged 45+ days in an electric atmosphere.

restaurants.name: Avec
restaurants.description: Beloved communal-table spot from Chef Paul Kahan, famous for chorizo-stuffed dates and seasonally-driven Mediterranean dishes.

activities.name: Chicago Architecture Boat Tour
activities.description: Cruise the Chicago River while learning about the city's world-famous architecture. Book with Chicago Architecture Center.

activities.name: Art Institute of Chicago
activities.description: World-class art museum featuring iconic works including American Gothic and A Sunday Afternoon on the Island of La Grande Jatte.

activities.name: Millennium Park & Cloud Gate
activities.description: See 'The Bean,' stroll through Lurie Garden, and enjoy free summer concerts at the Pritzker Pavilion.

activities.name: Skydeck Chicago (Willis Tower)
activities.description: Step onto The Ledge, a glass floor 1,353 feet above the ground with views of four states.

activities.name: Chicago Riverwalk
activities.description: 1.25-mile pedestrian path along the river with bars, restaurants, and kayak rentals.

activities.name: Second City Comedy Show
activities.description: Legendary improv comedy theater that launched careers of Tina Fey, Steve Carell, and more.

neighborhoods.name: River North
neighborhoods.description: High-energy neighborhood with great dining, galleries, and nightlife.

neighborhoods.name: West Loop
neighborhoods.description: Former meatpacking district turned culinary destination. Home to many celebrity chef restaurants.

neighborhoods.name: Lincoln Park
neighborhoods.description: Family-friendly neighborhood with the free Lincoln Park Zoo and gorgeous tree-lined streets.

neighborhoods.name: Lakeview
neighborhoods.description: Where we live! A vibrant, walkable neighborhood with excellent dining, easy lake access, and the best people-watching in the city.

neighborhoods.name: Boystown
neighborhoods.description: Chicago's iconic LGBTQ+ neighborhood packed with lively bars, amazing brunch spots, and a welcoming energy you can feel on every block.

neighborhoods.name: The Loop
neighborhoods.description: Downtown Chicago with iconic architecture, world-class theater, and major attractions.
